tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Subtle raised ground: table headers, footer, muted cards, hover rows.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second step of ground: neutral badges, selected rows, code blocks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions: card edges, table rules, nav bottom border. Decorative only — not for control outlines.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 against bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body copy under headings, table cells, card descriptions.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: help text, captions, table header labels, the tagline. ≥4.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (primary button, active switch in light). Midnight in light, electric-light in dark.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill for primary actions.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Electric blue. Large fills, the logo X, focus rings, selected-tab indicator, checked controls. Not for body-size text on white (≈4.5:1, borderline) — use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and small accent text. 6:1 on bg (light), 8:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for info alerts, accent badges, ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour (2px outline, 2px offset).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive state text/icon: Live, Connected, positive deltas.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution state text/icon: Paused, Degraded, pending.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive: Error status, negative deltas, destructive button fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for danger badges and alerts.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs.

tokens.name: logo-base
tokens.usage: Logo: lower S stroke. Midnight on light, pale blue on dark. Never recolour.

tokens.name: logo-accent
tokens.usage: Logo: upper S stroke and the X of the wordmark.

tokens.name: logo-text
tokens.usage: Logo: wordmark letters other than the X.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (Electric). The default single-series colour.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (Midnight; pale in dark).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. ≥3:1 against bg in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (Slate) — also comparison/benchmark lines.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above headings, in accent-text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every system is built to the client's requirement.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body, table primary column.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, nav links, form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase table headers and stat labels, in ink-3.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group; label-to-input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Alert padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter; container side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards and form groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tags, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and switches only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Raised buttons on hover; sticky nav once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Raised cards, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button/input height (dense tables, toolbars).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button/input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero call-to-action height.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Top navigation bar height.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width; centred with space-5 side padding.
